metadata.title: React Server Components: notes for Angular devs

base.anonce: RSC vs SSR vs SPA in 60 seconds.

content.text: RSC renders components on the server and streams payload to the client.
Server/Client boundaries are explicit; hooks differ.
Great for CMS/feeds; less for realtime dashboards.
